title: Cross-widget Cloudflare Turnstile isolation smoke
description: A real-browser smoke for extrachill-network's Cloudflare Turnstile integration, focused on the cross-widget isolation guarantee PHPUnit cannot reach: a broken widget's data-callback must not abort an unrelated sibling widget on the same page (the newsletter #17 / multisite #48 lackey bug). Ported from extrachill-network's own tests/browser/ (a standalone single-plugin wp-codebox recipe) onto the full 11-site network rig (extrachill-network#293); the single-plugin recipe, its shell runner, and its bespoke artifacts directory were dropped in favor of this journey.
